summary.headline: Orders and revenue both finished ahead of target, but the quarter stands at 92.6% of target with one week left.

points.what: Orders reached 101.5% of target and revenue 101.8% of target, with orders at 829 and revenue at $60,698.
points.so_what: Both weekly targets were met, but next week's revenue target of $68,006 sits well above this week's level.

points.what: QTD revenue is $654,201 against a target to date of $706,549, an attainment of 92.6%.
points.so_what: With one week left in the quarter, a single week at target does not close the quarter's shortfall.

points.what: Orders grew 60.0% and revenue 49.6% on last year, against the 75% growth the targets assume.
points.so_what: Growth is real but below the pace the 2026 targets were built on, which is why attainment keeps slipping behind for the year.

points.what: The cancellation rate rose to 16.4%, a third consecutive move in the bad direction from 14.3%.
points.so_what: The trend in cancellations is not reversing, and each percentage point carries $726 of revenue.

points.what: The cancellation rate has risen for three consecutive weeks, from 14.3% to 16.4%, a notable +1.0 pp move this week.
points.so_what: A sustained rise means more of each week's orders fall out before they contribute revenue.

points.what: Reaching the full-quarter target of $774,555 requires $120,354 in the final week, against $60,698 delivered this week.
points.so_what: The quarterly target is out of reach at anything close to the current weekly pace.

points.what: The full-year target needs $78,893 of revenue a week for the remaining 41 weeks, while the recent 8-week run-rate is $56,578.
points.so_what: The required pace sits far above the current one, so the year-to-date gap of $52,348 would keep widening.

points.what: Orders came in 12 above the weekly target of 817 and revenue $1,044 above the weekly target of $59,654.
points.so_what: The week cleared both targets, though by margins too small to change the quarter's position.

points.what: QTD and YTD revenue both stand at 92.6% of target, a gap of $52,348, with Jan and Feb behind target and Mar MTD at 100.6%.
points.so_what: March is the first month to hold target this year, but it does not offset the January and February shortfalls.

points.what: The rest of the year requires $78,893 a week versus the current 8-week run-rate of $56,578.
points.so_what: The full-year target of $3,888,802 is out of reach unless weekly revenue moves well above the recent pace.

points.what: APAC added 46 orders week on week to reach 387, a 143.8% share of the total change.
points.so_what: APAC alone more than accounts for the week's order growth, so the overall increase rests on one region.

points.what: LATAM fell 30.4% to 87 orders, a contribution of -38 orders.
points.so_what: LATAM offset most of the gains made elsewhere, holding total order growth to 4.0%.

points.what: Search added 34 orders to reach 596, a 106.2% share of the total change.
points.so_what: Order growth came from the largest source rather than from a broader lift across channels.

points.what: AOV rose 7.8% week on week to $87.59 but remains 5.0% below last year.
points.so_what: Revenue grew faster than orders this week, yet baskets are still smaller than a year ago, which caps revenue growth against the 75% target assumption.

points.what: The cancellation rate reached 16.4%, up 1.0 pp week on week and 1.3 pp on last year.
points.so_what: Each percentage point of cancellations is worth $726, so this week's rise carries a measurable revenue cost.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 02 Mar 2026 fell 1.4 pp to 9.2%, though it is 2.2 pp above last year.
points.so_what: Returns eased in that week but remain at a higher level than a year ago.

points.what: New signups fell 9.3% to 214 and were 1.4% below last year, while orders rose 4.0% and 60.0% respectively.
points.so_what: Order growth is not being matched by growth in new accounts.

checks.name: 14-Day Return Rate names its mature week
anomaly flag acknowledged in the summary
sentences at most 30 words and 4 numbers
each slot only covers its allowed KPIs
